description:
Scholarship amount and subject

This award supports the taught MA in Intercultural Studies. The official 2027/28 page lists full tuition support of HKD 190,000 and a living stipend of HKD 9,000 per month, totalling HKD 90,000. Applicants must follow the programme admission and scholarship instructions; the scholarship materials deadline is 15 January 2027.

Programme Overview

The CUHK MAICS Diversity and Inclusion Scholarship 2027-2028 is offered for the taught MA in Intercultural Studies (MAICS) at the Chinese University of Hong Kong. It provides full tuition plus monthly stipend for members of underrepresented groups.

Financial Coverage

  • Full tuition: HK$190,000 per annum.
  • Monthly stipend: HK$9,000 (total HK$90,000 living support).
  • Disbursed throughout the study period starting from the first semester.

Who Should Apply

  • Members of underrepresented groups in Hong Kong university postgraduate programmes. This includes applicants whose race, ethnicity, gender, religion, or nationality is not fully represented in the student body.
  • Leaders or trailblazers in different fields of cultural work.
  • Aspiring scholars who intend to pursue doctoral research.
  • Priority given to applicants with financial need who are citizens of Belt and Road Initiative countries: Southeast Asia, South Asia, Middle East, Latin America, and Africa.

Selection Criteria

  • Portfolio of work (critical, scholarly, or creative samples, press releases, achievements).
  • Application form, academic qualifications, work portfolio, financial need, and contribution potential.
  • Shortlisted applicants invited for panel interview.
  • Programme reserves the right not to award the scholarship if suitable candidates are not found.

Application dates

MilestoneDate
Application deadline15 January 2027
Results announcedMarch 2027

Application Process

  1. Apply for the MAICS programme through CUHK Graduate School online system. Pay application fee and obtain application number.
  2. Upload scholarship supporting documents through CUHK Graduate School Online System.
  3. Submit all materials by 15 January 2027.

Contact

maics@cuhk.edu.hk

Official Link

https://www2.crs.cuhk.edu.hk/maics/scholarships-and-awards

Related Award

MAICS Merit Award (HK$10,000, 5 students, final-year, CGPA 3.6+) is separate and for current students, not an entrance scholarship.
